description: Bayesian taxonomic assignment: likelihood x prior -> posterior probabilities

functions.name: run_llm_pipeline
functions.description: End-to-end LLM-shortcut workflow: auto-context, unreferenced detection, assignment, consensus, report

inputs.name: llm_fn
inputs.description: LLM provider function. Use TaxaTools::call_api (auto-selects provider). Valid names: call_api, call_anthropic_api, call_gemini_api, call_openai_api, call_azure_api, call_ollama_api. Do NOT invent other names.

inputs.name: backbone_id
inputs.description: Taxonomic backbone for taxonomy lookup. No default -- depends on which backbone the input taxonomy was verified against. Common values: 11 (GBIF), 4 (NCBI).

functions.scaling_note: Dominated by LLM API calls; ~1-2 min per 30 taxa

functions.name: run_bayesian_pipeline
functions.description: End-to-end Bayesian workflow: likelihoods + priors -> posterior -> consensus -> report

inputs.name: taxaexpect_priors
inputs.description: Prior probabilities from TaxaExpect (or build_priors() output)

inputs.name: site
inputs.description: Site specification: list(lat, lon) or list(grid_id, main_habitat)

inputs.name: backbone_id
inputs.description: Taxonomic backbone for taxonomy lookup. No default -- depends on which backbone the input taxonomy was verified against. Common values: 11 (GBIF), 4 (NCBI).

functions.scaling_note: Fast once model and priors are precomputed; ~10 sec for 500 samples

functions.name: assign_taxa_llm
functions.description: LLM-based assignment: score-derived likelihoods + LLM priors -> posteriors per sample

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: Site context from build_context(): ecoregion, main_habitat, date

inputs.name: context_group
inputs.description: Column for grouping taxa into context-specific batches

inputs.name: unreferenced_taxa
inputs.description: Named unreferenced species to include as hypotheses

inputs.name: known_present
inputs.description: Species known to be present (LLM context only)

output.description: Full posterior data frame with all hypotheses per sample

functions.scaling_note: LLM calls dominate; batches of 30 taxa per call

functions.name: build_context
functions.description: Auto-infer site context (habitat, ecoregion) from taxon names via LLM

inputs.name: habitat_scheme
inputs.description: Habitat scheme name: NULL (default 3-category), 'IUCN_L1', or 'IUCN_L2'. Pass a string, NOT a data frame.

output.description: One-row data frame: ecoregion, main_habitat, date

functions.scaling_note: 2-3 LLM calls regardless of taxon count

functions.name: score_consensus
functions.description: Simple score-based consensus: min_score + gap + rank_thresholds -> LCA. No model/priors needed.

inputs.name: rank_thresholds
inputs.description: Score thresholds per rank (e.g. c(species=98, genus=95, family=90)). No default (2026-07-23) -- errors if omitted, since the correct thresholds depend on marker/data type and no single value is safe to assume. Either supply real thresholds (e.g. the conventional GITA/Jonah Ventures c(species=98, genus=95, family=90, phylum=85)), derive marker-specific ones via TaxaLikely::compute_rank_thresholds() on your own reference data, or pass NULL explicitly to disable rank capping entirely. Auto-rescaled by /100 if the match score column looks like a 0-1 proportion rather than 0-100 percent identity.

inputs.name: min_score
inputs.description: Minimum score to consider. Note: min_score alone provides little species-vs-congener discrimination -- rank_thresholds does that job.

output.description: One row per observation_id with consensus assignment

functions.name: posterior_consensus
functions.description: LCA-based consensus from posterior: plausible hypotheses -> one assignment per sample

inputs.name: posterior_df
inputs.description: Posterior data frame from compute_posterior or assign_taxa_llm

inputs.name: backbone_id
inputs.description: Target backbone for taxonomy lookup, used only when lookup_missing_taxonomy = TRUE. No default -- depends on which backbone the input taxonomy was verified against. Common values: 11 (GBIF), 4 (NCBI).

inputs.name: species_reference
inputs.description: For downranking: reference with finer-rank taxa

inputs.name: group_priors
inputs.description: Optional output of compute_group_priors(). When supplied, consensus_prior becomes a real group-level SUM of theta across every locally modelled group member instead of a candidate-scoped max, and a new consensus_has_occurrence_record output column distinguishes 'checked, absent' from 'group_priors never supplied'

output.description: One row per observation_id with consensus_taxon, consensus_rank, consensus_posterior

functions.name: compute_posterior
functions.description: Core Bayes update: likelihood x prior -> posterior for each hypothesis

inputs.name: likelihood_w_prior
inputs.description: Data frame with likelihood and prior columns per hypothesis

output.description: Data frame with posterior_point_est, posterior_mean, posterior_sd per hypothesis

functions.scaling_note: Fast; ~1 sec per 1000 rows with MC

functions.name: join_priors
functions.description: Join TaxaExpect priors to a likelihood table by taxon_name + site. 'site' can be a single-site list OR a multi-site data frame -- see the site input below. When using the multi-site data-frame form, ALWAYS follow with combine_multisite_priors() before compute_posterior(), since an observation detected at more than one site produces one joined row per site

inputs.name: site
inputs.description: Single-site form: list(lat=, lon=, main_habitat=) or list(grid_id=, main_habitat=) -- applied to every observation. Multi-site form (data frame): columns observation_id, grid_id, main_habitat, OR observation_id, lat, lon, main_habitat -- one or more rows per observation_id. main_habitat is always required in either form

inputs.name: taxonomy_lookup
inputs.description: Optional taxon_name -> taxonomy-rank lookup (e.g. match_df) for species with likelihoods but absent from taxaexpect_priors

inputs.name: rank_system
inputs.description: Taxonomy ranks for joining, coarsest to finest. NULL auto-detects from likelihoods columns

inputs.name: backbone_id
inputs.description: Taxonomic backbone for taxonomy fallback fill. No default -- depends on which backbone the input taxonomy was verified against. Common values: 11 (GBIF), 4 (NCBI).

output.description: Likelihood table with prior columns (prior_alpha, prior_beta, grid_id, main_habitat, ...) added. Multi-site form: one row PER SITE per (observation_id, taxon_name) -- pass through combine_multisite_priors() before compute_posterior()

functions.name: combine_multisite_priors
functions.description: Combines duplicate (observation_id, taxon_name) rows produced by join_priors()'s multi-site data-frame path -- an observation detected at more than one site -- via precision-weighted logit combination. Correctly discounts a low-confidence/sparse-data site rather than a plain average or product. Single-site candidates pass through unchanged with n_sites_combined = 1

inputs.name: joined
inputs.description: Output of join_priors() with the multi-site data-frame 'site' argument -- must have observation_id, taxon_name, taxon_name_rank, grid_id, main_habitat, prior_alpha, prior_beta columns

output.description: Input with one row per (observation_id, taxon_name, taxon_name_rank), plus n_sites_combined (integer) and combined_sites (character, sites that were combined) columns. Ready for compute_posterior()

functions.name: suggest_unreferenced_species
functions.description: LLM-first unreferenced species detection: plausible species per genus not in reference

output.description: Character vector of unreferenced species; census and plausible in attributes

functions.scaling_note: LLM calls + optional NCBI verification; ~2-5 min

functions.name: generate_report
functions.description: Generate publication-ready Methods + Results text from pipeline outputs

inputs.name: result
inputs.description: Posterior data frame (required; pass consensus's own no-score equivalent if using the score-only pathway -- see TaxaAssign::posterior_consensus())

inputs.name: llm_fn
inputs.description: LLM for narrative Results (template if NULL)

inputs.name: study_description
inputs.description: Brief study context for report intro

functions.scaling_note: One LLM call for Results; template-only if llm_fn = NULL

functions.name: compute_group_priors
functions.description: Aggregates TaxaExpect occurrence priors up to genus/family (and species, auto-derived from taxon identity), producing a real group-level SUM of theta across every locally modelled member sharing a rank. Feeds posterior_consensus(group_priors=)'s consensus_prior, which otherwise stays candidate-scoped (a materially weaker statement, since one observation's own candidate set rarely contains every locally modelled group member).

inputs.name: taxaexpect_priors
inputs.description: Output of TaxaExpect's prior-generation functions (build_priors()/generate_full_priors()), with taxon_col and theta_col

inputs.name: taxonomy_map
inputs.description: A data frame with taxon_col plus real genus/family (or whatever rank_cols names) columns -- e.g. occurrences_clean, which typically has these even when taxaexpect_priors itself does not

inputs.name: taxon_col
inputs.description: Shared join key between the two inputs

inputs.name: theta_col
inputs.description: Column in taxaexpect_priors holding the occurrence-model share

inputs.name: rank_cols
inputs.description: Which columns in taxonomy_map to aggregate by; 'species' is auto-derived as taxon_col's own identity when taxonomy_map has no explicit species column

output.description: One row per (rank, taxon) group actually present: rank, taxon, theta_sum (capped at 1), n_members (locally modelled members contributing to the sum)

functions.scaling_note: Fast; pure aggregation over existing priors data
